commits.edited_message:
Bound structure slab readers and support rank 10

Keep indexed source access inside the allocated structure data and allow the rank-10 slab path covered by its fixed-size index arrays.

coupling: The first edited commit widens Mat_VarGetStructs from rank 9 to rank 10; with its original 10-entry idx/cnt/dimp arrays, that wider public contract is safe. The second edited commit later sizes those arrays for the historical rank-9 invariant. Read in isolation, rank is still capped at 9, so every index is in [0,8] and the nine-entry arrays are sufficient. Only the composition admits a valid rank-10 slab and then writes idx[9] (and can index cnt/dimp out of bounds) during dimension setup. A correct repair must reconcile the rank contract widened by the first commit with the array-capacity assumption introduced by the second; restoring the old guard alone rejects newly supported in-contract input, while restoring capacity alone leaves an implicit rank/capacity invariant that the two commits no longer share.
